# PayOps AI

> Payment reconciliation with a checked AI investigator. It compares what the gateway, order service, ledger, webhooks and settlement each say about a payment, opens a case when they disagree, cites evidence, proposes a fix and verifies the result. A person approves anything risky.

This is a portfolio project running on simulated data.
